{"id":1867260555,"question_id":4173,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1766898118,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1867260555/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Score of a Split","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long maximumScore(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<ll>prefix(n , 0);\n        vector<ll>suffix(n , 0);\n\n        prefix[0] = nums[0];\n        suffix[n-1] = -1;\n        suffix[n-2] = nums[n-1];\n        ll mini = min<ll>(nums[n-1] , nums[n-2]);\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] + nums[i];\n        }\n\n        for(int i = n-3 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            if(suffix[i] < mini)\n            {\n                suffix[i] = nums[i];\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                suffix[i] = mini;\n            }\n        }\n\n        ll maxi = INT_MIN;\n        for(int i = 0; i<n-1 ; i++)\n        {\n            maxi = max<ll>(maxi , prefix[i] - suffix[i]);\n        }\n    return maxi;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-score-of-a-split","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1414}
